summary: Boolean check with no arguments. Computes a float distance projection via DistanceProjectionCalc on the global dword_7C54E0 offset by 12, holding the result in v1, then returns whether either RingBufferAccessWithWrap(v1) or IndexedFloatArrayLookup(v1) equals 2. Called by sub_49D4C0 (0049d4c0), HUDFlagRendererMain (004d82d0) and GlobalFlagSetterViaFunctionCall (0059d948).

operations.description: DistanceProjectionCalc(dword_7C54E0 + 12) computes a float projection from the global dword_7C54E0 offset by 12; the float result is held in v1.
RingBufferAccessWithWrap(v1) indexes a ring buffer with wrap-around; the result is compared against 2.
IndexedFloatArrayLookup(v1) indexes a float array by the projection value; the result is compared against 2.
Returns true when either lookup equals 2, false otherwise.
